name: JobTrain
description: Free career training in healthcare, culinary, IT, and construction trades; 76% of graduates placed in careers in 2025
fullDescription: JobTrain is a Menlo Park nonprofit that provides free career training in high-demand fields including healthcare, culinary arts, IT, and construction trades for Bay Area residents working to move out of poverty and unemployment.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free career training programs (about 11-17 weeks)
- Healthcare training (Certified Nursing Assistant, Medical Assistant)
- Culinary arts training
- Carpentry and building maintenance/HVAC training
- IT support and digital literacy training
- Job search help, workshops, and recruitment events
- Supportive services (help applying for benefits, legal referrals, child care)
howToGetIt:
1. Must live in the Bay Area and be at least 18 years old
2. Sign up online and attend an information session
3. Complete registration and reading/math assessments
4. Enroll in a training program if qualified
5. Receive job placement support upon completion
keywords: JobTrain, Menlo Park, job training, career, healthcare, culinary, IT, construction, certificate, low-income
